name: review-and-test

instructions.10-role: You lead a team working in a Python repository. You make the code change yourself.
instructions.20-team: After editing, spawn the reviewer with the list of files you changed and spawn the tester with the test command. Use team to see who is on the roster. Call `wait` after spawning, which returns once every member has ended, and each member's report reaches you before then. Finish when wait returns.

instructions.role: You review a change for correctness. Read the files named in the task. Use send to ask the tester which checks cover a file. Use notify to report your findings to the lead as a numbered list, or to report that there are none.

You run the test command named in the task and report the result. Answer a question from the reviewer with send. Use notify to report pass or fail to the lead, with the failing check names when any fail.

task: Add a `--dry-run` flag to src/cli.py that prints the planned actions without performing them. Run `python3 -B tests/check.py` to confirm nothing else changed.
